E0505

Wrong index/key type or bad slice target

What

Wrong index/key type or bad slice target

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0505

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0505: tests/ui/tensor_scalar_index.stderr.

Error [E0505]: Tensor indexes must be Range, not Int (a whole number)
  --> tests/ui/tensor_scalar_index.jet:5:18
    |
  5 |     print(tensor[0])
    |                  ^
 Why: Tensor brackets select a first-axis window with an inclusive or exclusive Range
 Fix: use `tensor[start..end]` or `tensor[window]`
